article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A producer letter (titled "A Welcome Back Producer Letter") posted after Free Realms returned from a downtime. It says the team is working on new Farming items and a Ranching feature, previewed with screenshots that the article says are works in progress and subject to change. No dates, prices or release timing are given beyond "the near future".

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language producers' letter (posted about two weeks before the 2011-06-04 capture, exact date not shown) announcing that Free Realms had returned after a few days offline with a 'Welcome back' program. It says the team was working on new features, pointing to new farm items and an upcoming Livestock (Ganadería) feature, with images still in progress.

article_summaries.title: Carta de bienvenida de los productores de Free Realms® (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language producers' letter posted after Free Realms came back online following a few days of downtime. It announces a 'Welcome back' program (details linked, not in the text), says new farm items are now available, and teases Livestock (Ganadería) as a coming feature whose details were still unrevealed. Dates are not given in the copy.

article_summaries.title: Carta de Boas-vindas do Produtor (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Portuguese-language producer's letter welcoming players back after a downtime. It says the dev team spent recent weeks on upcoming features, mainly Agriculture (farming) and a Ranch, with more farm items to come. The Ranch was described as not yet finished, and all images were marked as work in progress.
